name: Passive fire protection — intumescent coatings and fireproofing
description: Insulate structural steel, vessels, raceways and divisions from cellulosic and hydrocarbon fires to maintain load-bearing capacity for a specified rating (e.g. H-0/H-60/H-120, R30–R180, 1–4 hours). Primary source: https://www.carboline.com/products/product-details/Thermo-Lag-3000-P

specifications.basis: Carboline product page and PDS: two-component epoxy intumescent fireproofing; tested UL 1709, UL 2431 Category I-A, ISO 834-3, IMO FTP Code (H-0/H-60/H-120), ASTM E84, ASTM E119, ISO 20340, NFPA 290 extended to 150 minutes

Fyfe FAQ: FRP does not reduce existing fire rating; no special protection for intermittent seismic/blast loads; Class 1/A flame & smoke per ASTM E84 may be needed for egress; Tyfo CFP for gravity-load cases
specifications.value: Tyfo CFP coating / Tyfo RR finish
